request_contract.parameter_rules: One original anonymous singleton DOI metadata GET was verified on 2026-11-03 at https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.4121%2F12706085.v4 (14,825 JSON bytes; captured SHA-256 90bbb620c7e04632e45b5c86c2998b3b023a55d246b56c2c7f09cc1a66c62f66). Future T1 metadata probes are restricted to one user-initiated GET per run using the fixed service root and DOI path, no caller-selected host, different DOI, parameters, pagination, arbitrary headers, credentials, mass harvesting, automatic retries or cross-origin redirects. The offline preflight separately verifies the raw response SHA-256 supplied by the caller. No 4TU original file-list/track-byte request, model ingestion or dataset admission is permitted by this metadata contract.

response_contract.format: DataCite public singleton DOI JSON:API metadata response (data.type=dois, exact data.id and attributes.doi).
response_contract.scientific_semantics: This DOI identifies STORM IBTrACS present-climate v4, a 10,000-synthetic-year tropical-cyclone track catalogue. Version v4 corrects past track-duplication and storm-category mistakes. A DataCite JSON record neither enumerates exact downloadable v4 files nor verifies their native schema, units, storm/year identity or hashes. Synthetic tracks are not observed storm records; tracks alone are not spatial wind/surge footprints or insured losses.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: DataCite official published public REST guidance permits anonymous DOI metadata retrieval/harvesting, with a provider limit of 500 requests per five minutes for unidentified clients (HTTP 429 when limited). Our own much narrower research boundary is at most one exact DOI metadata GET per user-initiated run, timeout 20s, <=256 KiB, no retry, no bulk harvesting or query expansion. Terms: https://support.datacite.org/docs/harvesting-datacite-doi-metadata and https://support.datacite.org/docs/rate-limit.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: DOI v4 is version-pinned but the public metadata record is mutable: original capture 2026-11-03, 14,825 bytes, SHA-256 90bbb620c7e04632e45b5c86c2998b3b023a55d246b56c2c7f09cc1a66c62f66, with provider reported metadata updated 2025-06-01T05:36:28Z. Any subsequent response must produce a new bounded original byte digest; a differing digest is not by itself evidence that STORM v4 track bytes changed. Track file inventory, sizes, checksums, native schema and year/event semantics remain separately unverified.

rights_and_policy.notes: The fixed DOI record and institutional v4 review identify synthetic STORM v4 dataset licence CC0-1.0; DataCite's original policy explicitly says DOI metadata themselves are openly CC0 and public anonymous REST metadata harvesting is supported. This supports a bounded metadata-only GET, NOT broad automation of 4TU original tracks, approval of original track-file republication, model use, or assumption that DataCite API rate limits license other providers. Commercial automated ingestion and redistribution decisions for provider track assets remain unknown and separate; the current source review is metadata-only.
